title: kith-peer: 30s delivery timeout serializes outbox — slow peer blocks all delivery
description: outbox_tick processes entries serially (phase 2 constraint). Each delivery attempt has a 30-second timeout covering DNS + TLS + HTTP. If a peer is unreachable or DNS is slow, one entry blocks all subsequent entries for up to 30 seconds. With N pending entries to N different unreachable peers, outbox_tick takes up to 30N seconds. Fix: run deliveries concurrently (bounded concurrency), or reduce the timeout, or at minimum document the serialization constraint.
